    • Constructor Detail

      • UserPrompt

        public UserPrompt(String header)
        Constructor for blank info type with a header only
        Parameters:
        header - text for the dialog title bar

      • UserPrompt

        public UserPrompt(String header,
          int type,
          String message)
        Constructor for user prompt with a header, message and prompt type

        header - text for the dialog title bar
        type - the prompt type

      • UserPrompt

        public UserPrompt(String header,
          int type,
          String message,
          boolean supressAbort)
        Constructor for user prompt with a header, message and prompt type; with the option to suppress automatic abort button rendering.
        Parameters:
        header - text for the dialog title bar
        type - the prompt type, (info, yes/no, flow_control_triflow, etc)
        message - the text or html format text message to be displayed within the prompt dialog
        supressAbort - if true, the auto generation of Abort buttons is suppressed.

      • UserPrompt

        public UserPrompt(String header,
          int type,
          String message,
          String[] buttonTexts,
          int[] buttonValues)
        Generic User Prompt constructor
        Parameters:
        header - text for the dialog title bar
        message - the text or html format text message to be displayed within the prompt dialog
        type - usually 'Generic'
        buttonTexts - an array of strings that will be the labels on the dialog buttons
        buttonValues - an array of integers that will be assigned to each button, and will be the return value when that button is clicked
